title: Fix login redirect loop and add token refresh retry

events.content: Fix the login redirect loop in src/auth/login.rs. When the session cookie expires the user bounces between /login and /dashboard forever.
The loop comes from login.rs treating an expired cookie as signed in. I will check expiry before redirecting.
Fixed the expiry check in src/auth/login.rs. Remaining work: add a regression test in tests/auth_redirect.rs and update the changelog.
Also add retry with backoff to the token refresh in src/auth/refresh.rs.
Retry with backoff is in place. Still open: cap the retries at five and log each attempt.
